'''2016 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Matt Wadden DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wadden]] at [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Wadden]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Invasion Wadden DS 2016 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130753/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]
